mapper.sql: id, job_type, year, period_code, kpi_id, schedule_id, `trigger`, started_at, finished_at, status, total, success, failed, message, triggered_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sync_batch (job_type, year, period_code, kpi_id, schedule_id, `trigger`, started_at, status, triggered_by) VALUES (#{jobType}, #{year}, #{periodCode}, #{kpiId}, #{scheduleId}, #{trigger}, NOW(3), 'DANG_CHAY', #{triggeredBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE sync_batch SET status = #{status}, total = #{total}, success = #{success}, failed = #{failed}, message = #{message}, finished_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sync_batch WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM sync_batch WHERE job_type = #{jobType} ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sync_batch_item (batch_id, formula_definition_id, org_unit_id, request_summary, value, error, at) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{formulaId}, #{orgUnitId}, #{request}, #{value}, #{error}, NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, o.code AS unitCode, o.name AS unitName, f.code AS formulaCode, i.request_summary AS request, i.error FROM sync_batch_item i LEFT JOIN org_unit o ON o.id = i.org_unit_id LEFT JOIN formula_definition f ON f.id = i.formula_definition_id WHERE i.batch_id = #{batchId} AND i.error IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.id LIMIT 1000

SELECT i.id, i.at, b.`trigger` AS `trigger`, b.year, b.period_code AS periodCode, o.code AS unitCode, o.name AS unitName, i.value, i.error, i.request_summary AS request FROM sync_batch_item i JOIN sync_batch b ON b.id = i.batch_id LEFT JOIN org_unit o ON o.id = i.org_unit_id WHERE i.formula_definition_id = #{formulaId} ORDER BY i.at DESC, i.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
